task.title: Register storage/backup reports and operations sampling
task.input: JobState, controlled server scripts and existing backup metadata
task.output: The ops-sample job, POST /api/internal/ops-report and a read-only reporting script
task.accept: 1) Caller controlled deployment script leads to POST /api/internal/ops-report, with strict Bearer/allowlist/time-range checks; send only space counters/backup-completion metadata, without sending contents or allowing arbitrary path reads; show not connected when no verifiable source exists (E-65, E-66). 2) Actually register ops-sample in registry/cron and show real measuredAt/lastSucceededAt; stopping reports must not fake freshness, auxiliary exceptions must not block core stats, and unobserved chains must not show healthy (E-54, E-64, E-67).
